player_prompt.intro:
Jani Wakichiri {player_id} Wild Tic Tac Toe jikxatasi.
Ukhamäwipxäti, jani 'X' utji 'O' ukham jach'a q'awirinakax utji.
Jani ukhamäwipxäti, maynix q'awirinakax juk'ampis utji (X utji O) jach'a apthapinakax.
Jani ukhamäwipxäti, maynix q'alla (X utji O) ukhamäwipxäti.
Jach'a apthapinakax utji, '[X 4]' walt'awinakax utji, 'X' ukham jach'a q'awirinakax.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jan walt'awi apthapinakax. '[X 4]' utji '[O 2]' walt'awinakax utji.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Jan wali jakhu: {cell}. 0 ukat 8 ukch'a taypinkañapawa.

game_action.placed: Wakichiri {player_id} ukhax jach'a q'alla ({mark}) ukax q'awirinakax {cell}
